provider_scope: Unchanged local checkpoints; no model swaps.
quality_gate: Unchanged paired checkpoint gate: no fewer elimination wins, no more losses/caps/deaths, no slower aggregate ticks among common elimination wins, with a strict quality gain. Explicitly report the small one-map holdout and do not claim global optimality.
iteration_stop: One frozen conditional candidate. Reject if screen regresses; no retuning on holdout. No automatic UI promotion.
hypothesis: Global route-prior removal and global stronger repetition penalties both produced combat survival regressions. Only intervene when the incumbent search plan has repeat-visit sum >=3 and predicts at most 12 damage in either opponent rollout. Then drop route bias and strengthen repetition cost, restricting roots to at least the incumbent's worst predicted survivors. Outside this condition preserve v3 ranking exactly.
safety: Cycles03/04 failed CPU-only screens and receive no model calls. Reuse their development maps openly; this holdout has not been inspected. No cloud, retries, warmup, weights changes or user-match interruption.
